# langsmith_permissions (Data Source)

Lists LangSmith permissions available for roles.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "langsmith_permissions" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Static data source ID.
- `permissions` (Attributes List) LangSmith permissions available for roles. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--permissions))
